scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,gateway,orders,products,realtime -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @inventory/web" "PORT=3100 npm run dev -w @inventory/gateway" "npm run dev -w @inventory/orders-service" "npm run dev -w @inventory/products-service" "npm run dev -w @inventory/realtime-service"
scripts.db:generate: prisma generate --config backend/orders-service/prisma.config.ts && prisma generate --config backend/products-service/prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate: prisma migrate dev --config backend/orders-service/prisma.config.ts && prisma migrate dev --config backend/products-service/prisma.config.ts
